caption: Newanforbi v. Rojo
key_facts: Agent Rojo assumed AOR on Nov. 19, 2025 and withheld finalized Discharge Review Report from Plaintiff. Perpetuated unlawful retention. State court action asserting Bane Act, IIED, and Negligence claims.
procedural_status: Filed July 7, 2026. Gov. Claim presented 05/19/2026 (Confirmation No. 26051930365359, Ex. E); deemed rejected 07/03/2026 (45 days, Gov. Code §912.4(c)). Filed within 6-month suit deadline under Gov. Code §945.6(a)(1). Suit deadline: Jan. 3, 2027.
risk: FLAGGED — potential claim-preclusion exposure: this matter arises from the same Nov. 17–21, 2025 travel-denial incident as Matter 21 (federal, naming Rojo), which was voluntarily dismissed WITH PREJUDICE on June 29, 2026, one week before this state action was filed July 7, 2026. A with-prejudice dismissal is ordinarily treated as an adjudication on the merits for claim-preclusion purposes, and because Matter 21 was a federal-question §1983 case, this state-law Bane Act/IIED/negligence claim on the same transaction could have been brought there under supplemental jurisdiction (28 U.S.C. §1367) — giving Rojo a credible res judicata/claim-splitting defense not addressed anywhere in this record. Neither this matter nor Matter 21 discloses the other as a related/parallel action arising from the same incident. (Separately, this matter's key_facts field describes an 'AOR/discharge review withholding' scenario that does not match the actual filed complaint — a pre-existing documentation gap this note doesn't resolve.)
